listings.name: TikTok hook writer
listings.summary: Writes ten scroll-stopping first lines for a short video and ranks them.
listings.text:
---
name: tiktok-hook-writer
description: Write and rank opening hooks for short vertical videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts).
license: Proprietary (AIKING)
---

# TikTok hook writer

Use when someone needs the first 1–3 seconds of a short video.

1. Ask for the product, the viewer, and the single promise if any is missing. Do not invent claims or prices.
2. Write 10 hooks, each under 12 words, across these patterns: problem call-out, surprising number, before/after, "stop doing X", POV, question, demo-first.
3. Rank the top 3 by clarity, curiosity and how fast the payoff can be shown on screen. Give one line of reasoning each.
4. For the winner, add the matching first shot (what the viewer sees) and on-screen text.

Return a table: hook | pattern | first shot. Mark anything that needs a claim checked.

listings.name: Image prompt builder
listings.summary: Turns a visual idea into layered prompts for Flux, Midjourney or SDXL.
listings.text:
---
name: image-prompt-builder
description: Build structured image-generation prompts with subject, scene, light, lens and constraints.
license: Proprietary (AIKING)
---

# Image prompt builder

1. Confirm the goal (ad, thumbnail, product shot, concept) and the target model.
2. Write the prompt in layers: subject → action → setting → lighting → camera/lens → style → color → composition → quality terms.
3. Add a negative prompt for common failures: extra fingers, warped text, duplicated objects, plastic skin.
4. Give the aspect ratio and, when relevant, seed and guidance values to try.
5. Offer two variants that change one layer each (for example, light or lens) so results can be compared.

Keep each prompt under 120 words. Never include a real person's likeness without stated permission.

listings.name: Video shot list
listings.summary: Breaks a script into timed shots with camera, motion and on-screen text.
listings.text:
---
name: video-shot-list
description: Break a short video script into a timed shot list with camera, motion and text overlays.
license: Proprietary (AIKING)
---

# Video shot list

1. Read the script and the target length. Default to 15 seconds and 9:16.
2. Split it into shots of 1–3 seconds. For each shot give: time range, what is on screen, camera (angle, lens, movement), on-screen text, and audio.
3. Front-load the payoff: the product or result appears by second 3.
4. End with a clear call to action shot.
5. Flag shots that need real footage versus ones an AI video model can generate.

listings.name: Campaign brief
listings.summary: One-page brief: audience, promise, proof, channels and success metric.
listings.text:
---
name: campaign-brief
description: Write a one-page campaign brief with audience, promise, proof, channels, budget and one success metric.
license: Proprietary (AIKING)
---

# Campaign brief

Write one page with these headings: Goal, Audience, Single promise, Proof, Offer, Channels, Creative angles (3), Budget and timing, Success metric, Risks.

- One measurable success metric, with the number to beat.
- Proof must be real (reviews, data, demos). Write "needs proof" where none was given.
- Keep it under 400 words.

listings.name: A/B test plan
listings.summary: Designs a creative test with one variable, sample size and a stop rule.
listings.text:
---
name: ab-test-plan
description: Plan an A/B test for ads or landing pages with one variable, a sample size and a stop rule.
license: Proprietary (AIKING)
---

# A/B test plan

1. State the hypothesis as "Changing X will move metric Y because Z".
2. Change one variable only. List what stays fixed.
3. Estimate the sample needed for the expected lift at 80% power, and say the assumption used.
4. Define the stop rule and the decision for each outcome before the test starts.
5. Note seasonality or budget changes that would invalidate the result.

listings.name: Competitor scan
listings.summary: Compares competitors' offers, angles and creative with sources.
listings.text:
---
name: competitor-scan
description: Compare competitors' offers, prices, messaging angles and creative formats, with sources.
license: Proprietary (AIKING)
---

# Competitor scan

For each competitor give: offer, price, main promise, proof used, creative formats seen, and one weakness to exploit.
Cite a source link for every fact. Write "not found" instead of guessing.
Finish with three angles nobody in the set is using.

listings.name: Release notes
listings.summary: Turns merged changes into short notes people can act on.
listings.text:
---
name: release-notes
description: Turn a list of merged changes into short release notes grouped by what users notice.
license: Proprietary (AIKING)
---

# Release notes

Group changes into New, Improved and Fixed. One line each, written for the person using the product.
Leave out internal refactors unless they change behavior. Link the pull request when one is given.

listings.name: Meeting notes
listings.summary: Captures decisions, owners and dates from a transcript.
listings.text:
---
name: meeting-notes
description: Summarize a meeting transcript into decisions, action items with owners and dates, and open questions.
license: Proprietary (AIKING)
---

# Meeting notes

Return three sections: Decisions, Action items (owner, task, due date), Open questions.
Quote the transcript when a decision is ambiguous. Never assign an owner who did not agree to the task.

listings.name: AIKING Toolbox
listings.summary: Local MCP tools: word count, slugify and aspect-ratio sizes. Runs on this computer, no account.

server.name: aiking-toolbox
args: const rl=require('readline').createInterface({input:process.stdin});const send=(m)=>process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(m)+'\n');const tools=[{name:'word_count',description:'Count words and characters in a text.',inputSchema:{type:'object',properties:{text:{type:'string'}},required:['text']}},{name:'slugify',description:'Turn a title into a URL slug.',inputSchema:{type:'object',properties:{text:{type:'string'}},required:['text']}},{name:'aspect_ratio',description:'Pixel size for a ratio such as 9:16 at a given width.',inputSchema:{type:'object',properties:{ratio:{type:'string'},width:{type:'number'}},required:['ratio','width']}}];const run=(n,a)=>{if(n==='word_count'){const t=String(a.text||'');return {words:(t.trim().match(/\S+/g)||[]).length,characters:t.length};}if(n==='slugify')return {slug:String(a.text||'').toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'')};if(n==='aspect_ratio'){const [w,h]=String(a.ratio).split(':').map(Number);return {width:a.width,height:Math.round(a.width*h/w)};}throw new Error('Unknown tool '+n);};rl.on('line',(line)=>{let m;try{m=JSON.parse(line);}catch{return;}if(m.id===undefined)return;try{let r;if(m.method==='initialize')r={protocolVersion:(m.params&&m.params.protocolVersion)||'2025-06-18',capabilities:{tools:{}},serverInfo:{name:'aiking-toolbox',version:'1.0.0'}};else if(m.method==='tools/list')r={tools};else if(m.method==='ping')r={};else if(m.method==='tools/call')r={content:[{type:'text',text:JSON.stringify(run(m.params.name,m.params.arguments||{}))}]};else{send({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:m.id,error:{code:-32601,message:'Method not found'}});return;}send({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:m.id,result:r});}catch(e){send({jsonrpc:'2.0',id:m.id,result:{isError:true,content:[{type:'text',text:String(e.message)}]}});}});
